title.en: Legal plunder and "the fatal tendency of mankind"
title.nl: Legal plunder and "the fatal tendency of mankind"

summary.fa: باستیا می‌گوید انسان دو راه برای برآوردن نیازش دارد: کار، که منشأ مالکیت است، و ربودن محصول کار دیگران، که منشأ چپاول است. چون کار سخت است، چپاول تا زمانی ادامه دارد که آسان‌تر از کار باشد — و کار قانون همین است که آن را سخت‌تر کند. ولی چون قانون را خود آدم‌ها می‌نویسند، معمولاً عکس این می‌شود.
summary.en: Bastiat argues man has two ways to meet his wants: labour, the origin of property, and seizing the fruits of others’ labour, the origin of plunder. Since labour is hard, plunder continues as long as it is easier than labour — and law’s task is to make it harder. But since law is written by men, the opposite usually happens.
summary.nl: Bastiat argues man has two ways to meet his wants: labour, the origin of property, and seizing the fruits of others’ labour, the origin of plunder. Since labour is hard, plunder continues as long as it is easier than labour — and law’s task is to make it harder. But since law is written by men, the opposite usually happens.

text.fa: دو گرایش مشترک: یکی مراقبت از خود و رشد، که اگر هر کس آزادانه از استعدادش بهره برد و در ثمرهٔ کارش تصرف کند جامعه بی‌وقفه پیشرفت می‌کند؛ و دیگری این‌که «چنانچه شرایط فراهم باشد، انسان‌ها علاقه دارند به هزینهٔ دیگران زندگی نموده و موفقیت کسب نمایند».
text.en: Two shared tendencies: the first is self-preservation and development, so that if everyone may use his faculties freely and dispose of the fruits of his labour, society advances without interruption; the second is that "given the opportunity, men like to live and prosper at the expense of others."
text.nl: Two shared tendencies: the first is self-preservation and development, so that if everyone may use his faculties freely and dispose of the fruits of his labour, society advances without interruption; the second is that "given the opportunity, men like to live and prosper at the expense of others."

text.fa: و باستیا این را ادعایی شتاب‌زده نمی‌داند و شاهد تاریخی می‌آورد: «جنگ‌های پی در پی، مهاجرت‌های بی‌رویه، شکنجه‌های مذهبی، برده‌داری جهانی، بی‌صداقتی در تجارت و انحصارها». ریشه‌اش را در «غریزهٔ اولیه، عمومی و غیرقابل کنترل» ارضای خواسته با کمترین سختی می‌بیند.
text.en: He does not treat this as a hasty claim and offers historical evidence: "successive wars, mass migrations, religious persecutions, universal slavery, dishonesty in commerce and monopolies." He locates its root in the "primitive, universal and uncontrollable instinct" to satisfy wants with the least effort.
text.nl: He does not treat this as a hasty claim and offers historical evidence: "successive wars, mass migrations, religious persecutions, universal slavery, dishonesty in commerce and monopolies." He locates its root in the "primitive, universal and uncontrollable instinct" to satisfy wants with the least effort.

text.fa: دو منشأ: «انسان می‌تواند زندگی کند و با کار بی‌وقفه و به‌کارگیری مستمر استعدادهای خود بر منابع طبیعی نیازهای خود را برآورده سازد؛ این روند منشأ مالکیت است. اما این نیز صحیح است که انسان ممکن است نیازهای خود را با ربودن و استفاده از محصولات کار دیگران برآورده سازد. این روند منشأ چپاول است.»
text.en: Two origins: "man can live and satisfy his wants by ceaseless labour, applying his faculties to natural resources; this is the origin of property. But it is also true that man may satisfy his wants by seizing and using the products of others’ labour. This is the origin of plunder."
text.nl: Two origins: "man can live and satisfy his wants by ceaseless labour, applying his faculties to natural resources; this is the origin of property. But it is also true that man may satisfy his wants by seizing and using the products of others’ labour. This is the origin of plunder."

text.fa: قاعدهٔ توقف: «انسان‌ها تا زمانی که چپاول ساده‌تر از کار است روی به چپاول خواهند آورد… نه مذهب و نه اخلاق نمی‌توانند جلوی این موضوع را بگیرند. چپاول زمانی متوقف خواهد شد که سخت‌تر و خطرناک‌تر از کار شود.» پس هدف والای قانون همین است.
text.en: The stopping rule: "men will turn to plunder as long as plunder is easier than labour… neither religion nor morality can prevent it. Plunder will stop when it becomes harder and more dangerous than labour." Hence the law’s high purpose.
text.nl: The stopping rule: "men will turn to plunder as long as plunder is easier than labour… neither religion nor morality can prevent it. Plunder will stop when it becomes harder and more dangerous than labour." Hence the law’s high purpose.

text.fa: و پارادوکس: قانون را یک شخص یا گروهی از اشخاص وضع می‌کنند و اجرای آن بدون قدرت حاکم ممکن نیست، پس آن قدرت به واضعان قانون واگذار می‌شود. این واقعیت به‌علاوهٔ همان گرایش «تقریباً حاکی از انحراف عمومی قانون است».
text.en: And the paradox: law is made by a person or group, and cannot be enforced without a sovereign power, so that power is handed to the lawmakers. This fact plus the same tendency "all but guarantees a universal perversion of the law."
text.nl: And the paradox: law is made by a person or group, and cannot be enforced without a sovereign power, so that power is handed to the lawmakers. This fact plus the same tendency "all but guarantees a universal perversion of the law."

text.fa: تحریف کامل قانون: «قانون نیروی مشترکی را در دسترس افراد بی‌وجدان گذارده تا بدون این‌که خطری را متحمل شوند شخصیت، آزادی و اموال دیگران را استثمار نمایند. قانون، چپاول را به یک حق تبدیل کرده است تا از آن حمایت نماید و دفاع مشروع را به یک جرم تبدیل نموده تا آن را مجازات نماید.»
text.en: The complete perversion of the law: "law has placed the collective force at the disposal of the unscrupulous, so that they may exploit the person, liberty and property of others without risk. Law has turned plunder into a right in order to protect it, and lawful defence into a crime in order to punish it."
text.nl: The complete perversion of the law: "law has placed the collective force at the disposal of the unscrupulous, so that they may exploit the person, liberty and property of others without risk. Law has turned plunder into a right in order to protect it, and lawful defence into a crime in order to punish it."

text.fa: دو علت تحریف، نه یکی: «طمع احمقانه و انسان‌دوستی غلط». علت دوم مهم است: اگر اعانه و کمک به نیازمندان داوطلبانه نباشد، آزادی و عدالت را تخریب می‌کند، زیرا «قانون نمی‌تواند چیزی را ببخشد که ابتدا از مالک آن سلب مالکیت نشده است».
text.en: Two causes of the perversion, not one: "stupid greed and false philanthropy." The second matters: if charity is not voluntary it destroys liberty and justice, because "the law cannot give away anything that has not first been taken from its owner."
text.nl: Two causes of the perversion, not one: "stupid greed and false philanthropy." The second matters: if charity is not voluntary it destroys liberty and justice, because "the law cannot give away anything that has not first been taken from its owner."

text.fa: قربانیان چپاول قانونی و پویایی سیاسی: وقتی چپاول به نفع واضعان قانون سازمان یافت، گروه‌های زیان‌دیده می‌کوشند سهم خود را بگیرند، پس «همه افراد ممکن است خواهان مشارکت در وضع قانون شوند، خواه به منظور حفاظت از خود علیه چپاول، خواه برای استفاده از آن به منظور چپاول». نتیجه: «سؤال‌های سیاسی همیشه مخرب، مسلط و جذاب برای همه هستند» و در برابر کاخ قانون‌گذاری جنگ درمی‌گیرد.
text.en: The victims of legal plunder and the political dynamic: once plunder is organized for the lawmakers’ benefit, the injured groups try to get their share, so "everyone may want a part in making the law, whether to protect himself against plunder or to use it for plunder." The result: "political questions are always destructive, dominant and attractive to everyone," and a struggle breaks out before the legislative palace.
text.nl: The victims of legal plunder and the political dynamic: once plunder is organized for the lawmakers’ benefit, the injured groups try to get their share, so "everyone may want a part in making the law, whether to protect himself against plunder or to use it for plunder." The result: "political questions are always destructive, dominant and attractive to everyone," and a struggle breaks out before the legislative palace.

text.fa: آزمون تشخیص که ریچمن از متن بیرون می‌کشد: چپاول قانونی را با جستجوی قوانینی می‌توان شناخت که دادن دارایی یکی به دیگری را مجاز می‌کنند؛ «مواردی را در نظر بیاوریم که قانون به شهروندی به هزینهٔ دیگری سود برساند در حالی که واسط این سودرسانی عملی است که برای شخص بدون ارتکاب جرم امکان‌پذیر نمی‌باشد».
text.en: The identification test Richman draws from the text: legal plunder can be spotted by looking for laws that authorize giving one person’s property to another; "consider cases where the law benefits one citizen at another’s expense by an act which, done by a private person, would be a crime."
text.nl: The identification test Richman draws from the text: legal plunder can be spotted by looking for laws that authorize giving one person’s property to another; "consider cases where the law benefits one citizen at another’s expense by an act which, done by a private person, would be a crime."

text.fa: این مدخل استدلال باستیا را گزارش می‌کند، نه تأیید می‌کند. حکم‌های او دربارهٔ طبیعت انسان و تاریخ هیچ شاهد کمّی ندارند، و دامنهٔ آزمون «چپاول قانونی» عملاً بیشتر سیاست‌های بازتوزیعی را در بر می‌گیرد — چیزی که خودِ ریچمن هم آشکارا می‌پذیرد. نقد مقابل در دعوای دولت رفاه آمده است.
text.en: This entry reports Bastiat’s argument, it does not endorse it. His claims about human nature and history carry no quantitative evidence, and the "legal plunder" test in practice captures most redistributive policy — which Richman openly accepts. The opposing case is set out in the welfare-state debate.
